answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is anchored to capital, forcing an attacker to acquire a massive stake to control the network. This economic threshold ensures that identity fabrication remains prohibitively expensive, protecting the integrity of autonomous agent consensus.
